items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: we didn't have the good dancers because 'cause Baby Laurence was one of the greatest dancers in the world

ctx.x: What made you decide to leave Cleveland?

Well I had just got the Highlanders -- this one I called the Rocking Highlanders. I tried to revive the other thing, because we were just about as near -- we didn't have the good dancers because 'cause Baby Laurence was one of the greatest dancers in the world -- was among those guys.
Did Snags Allen know that you were reviving that?
